text:
Priya Rao: Quick sync — PRD draft for Observability Console (dashboards + traces + retention). Need to lock scope for the milestone. Main open questions: retention tiers, trace sampling defaults, and launch acceptance criteria. Draft: https://redwood.internal/prds/obs-console-draft
Raj Patel: skimming. do we have customer asks that force >90d retention? cc @Emily
Emily Chen: Two mid-market customers asked for 180d exports, but they'd pay for add-on. For GA I think 30/90 default tiers + paid 180 is fine.
Sam Ortiz: Agree. Also need UX for the retention change — it's not obvious for admins. We should add a confirmation modal and an audit log entry.
Priya Rao: Good call. Adding to PRD: confirmation modal + audit log + migration notes. @Jordan any infra constraints on storing 180d raw traces?
Jordan Lee: Storage/ingest is fine for 180d if we enforce sampling and compressed storage. Concern: trace search latency for long windows. Recommend: index only the first 7 days for trace-level queries; longer windows use rollups.
Emily Chen: That tradeoff needs to be explicit in acceptance criteria. Users must understand query semantics differ by window.
Priya Rao: Draft acceptance checklist (wip):
```
- Dashboards: token-level cost breakdowns available for top 10 routes
- Retention tiers: UI to set 30/90/180 with guardrails + confirm modal
- Traces: default sampling at 10% across workloads, configurable per-route
- Query semantics: detailed docs + UI warning when window >7d (rollup mode)
- Rollout: canary to 5% traffic then 50% then full, with auto-rollback on SLO regressions
- E2E tests: perf for 95th p50 latency under baseline workload
```
Priya Rao: Anything missing?
Raj Patel: Add migration plan for existing customers who have custom retention. Also include a customer opt-in for 180d (billing flow).
Sam Ortiz: Edge case: customer requests 0d retention (legal purge) — PRD should specify immediate-job and confirmation + SLA for purges.
Jordan Lee: For purge jobs: need rate limits and backpressure to not overwhelm storage infra. Add max parallel purge jobs per org.
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "canary rollout scheduled: obs-console-v2 -> 2024-11-02 03:00 UTC (will run 5% for 2h)"
Emily Chen: Nice. For launch criteria, propose we require: 1) core features shipped, 2) no P0/P1 regressions in canary for 48h, 3) performance within 10% of baseline, 4) docs + migration guide published.
Priya Rao: Sounds good. I'll update PRD with these and tag eng owners. Plan: finalize scope by EOD Friday, then RFC for prod review next week.
Sam Ortiz: Quick UX note — retention modal should show estimated monthly cost delta when switching tiers.
Priya Rao: Added. Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark PRD as ready-for-review in 24h and circulate to sales/support for feedback. :thumbsup:
